about:
# ZacUI

A complete, fully customizable interface for WoW Classic Era, TBC Anniversary and WoW Forever: unit frames,
nameplates, action bars, bags, damage and threat meter, class HUDs, raid mods, raid tools, maps and more.

**Download:** [ZacUI on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/zacui) (or the CurseForge app).
Each `Zacui*` folder goes in `Interface\AddOns`. Type `/zacui` in game to open the settings.

`/zacui flavor` lists what works differently on the game version you're playing.

Credits for the libraries and OpenMap's seamless world map (MIT) are in
[`Zacui/CREDITS.md`](https://github.com/Zac175/ZacUI/blob/main/Zacui/CREDITS.md). All rights reserved for ZacUI's own code.

releases.notes:
# ZacUI 3.0.21: The website's new address, a raid timer that waits for the pull, and Oil of Immolation on the swing timer

## Changed
- The website has a new address: zacaddons.com. The report, suggest and website buttons, and /zui report and /zui suggest, now open it.

## Fixed
- Raid timer: a buff or ability used before the pull (a Bloodrage, say) started the clock early. It now starts at the first hit on an enemy.
- Swing timer: using Oil of Immolation starts your swing over, and the swing bar now shows that.

# ZacUI 3.0.20: A website for reports and ideas, and lists that show every choice whole

## Added
- ZacUI has a website: what changed in every version, bug reports and feature suggestions. /zui report and /zui suggest give you the link with your version filled in. So do the buttons under Need help? on the Overview page and the headset button beside Discord and Twitch.
- Action bars: a key name too long for its button is drawn a little smaller so the whole name shows. A tick under Keys turns it off.
- Tooltips: a skinnable corpse can show the skinning skill it needs. Off until you turn it on.
- Bags: items you cannot use can be tinted. Off until you turn it on.
- Unit frames: the power bar can hide on a target that has no mana, rage or energy. Off until you turn it on.
- Profiles: an exported profile remembers the screen it was made on, and importing it on a different screen says so.
- Scrolling text: the extra attacks line (Windfury) is offered on WoW Forever, and /zui combattext lists what the game reports there.

## Changed
- Dropdown lists are as wide as their longest choice, so nothing in an open list is cut short.

## Fixed
- Searching the settings made the game stutter. It no longer does.
- Dropdown lists opened bigger or smaller than their box when the settings window was not at 100%.
- Settings window: two page descriptions were cut short, and one row in the unit frames preview's list stuck out.
- Auction house: the Auctions column heading was cut short.

# ZacUI 3.0.19: Timers that catch up when you join late, and easier bag pins

## Added
- Pull and break timers: join a group late, or log in while one is running, and the bar catches up. A running break is asked from the group's ZacUI and DBM users, a pull countdown from its ZacUI users.
- /zui timers shows what the pull and break timers asked for and what came back, for when a bar does not show.
- Bags: take an item out of the pinned row with the x in its corner while you hold Alt, or right-click the + for a list of everything pinned. The Bags page, Look tab, picks the key.

## Fixed
- A cooldown that began before your PC was restarted showed as a full, greyed cooldown on bag items, bars and trackers. It shows the time really left.
- Warrior HUD: the second trinket's icon shows its active time, and each trinket icon shows its own trinket's buff. Any trinket you use shows its active time.
- Party frames under the Classic, WoW Forever and Blizzard styles: the samples in move mode and in the settings look like the real frames, and the real ones no longer sit off to one side after a size change.
- Seamless map: an error that could come up while the map window changed size.

# ZacUI 3.0.18: A chat window that stays put in raids

## Fixed
- With "Same chat size and spot on every character" on, the chat window could jump to the game's default place and back over and over in a raid, and the raid or party frames in the chat box went with it or were left out of place until the fight ended. The window stays on its spot.

# ZacUI 3.0.17: A size for every piece on screen, a macro cleaner, and boss loot

## Added
- One size for everything ZacUI puts on screen: a slider on the Movers page and in Edit Mode. It reaches the class HUD, trackers, timers, alerts, consumable bars, unit frames, action bars, nameplates and meter windows.
- Edit Mode: each piece has its own size. Pick a piece to make it smaller or bigger, or to set its width, height, icon size and spacing right there.
- Class HUDs: every piece has its own scale, and the mana and energy tick strips have a height.
- Macro cleaner: every macro in one list with a tick. Delete many at once, see which ones nothing uses, and bring one back from the bin. Open it with /zui macros or the Clean up button on the macro window.
- The macro cleaner can also delete by itself: macros another addon keeps making, or macros that have gone unused for a number of days. Off until you turn it on under Quality of life, Macros.
- Boss loot: a small card of what a boss dropped and who got it. Off until you turn it on under Quality of life.
- Loot rolls: a card style with the item's name, bind type and time left, and every part of it is a setting. A new install starts with it; yours stays as it was until you pick it.
- Loot rolls: the need, greed and pass buttons can wear the game's 3D art or flat icons.
- Seamless map: Map style in its menu, to go back to the game's map or choose again.
- Tooltips: a tick to hide the "Made by" line on crafted items.

## Changed
- Borders and thin lines are one screen pixel wide at every UI scale.
- Class HUDs: a new setup places the trinket row where every screen size shows it. A HUD already set up keeps its place.

## Fixed
- Bars, timers and other pieces could draw over the open world map. They go behind it now and come back when it closes.
- Seamless map: dragging the map's header did not move the map.
- Changing a meter window's scale from its header menu moved the window. It stays in place.
